Dashboard.welcomeHint: Booking tools will appear here as they are built.

settings.title: Venue settings
settings.occasionsHint: Each occasion has one price, whatever the slot. A deactivated occasion is no longer offered; existing bookings keep their price.
settings.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? It will no longer be offered. Existing bookings keep their price and are unaffected.
settings.depositHint: Between 1 and 100. Rounded to whole EGP for each booking.
settings.cutoffHint: A slot starting sooner than this cannot be held online.
settings.urgentHint: A hold on a slot starting within this time is flagged urgent.
settings.noPayment: No payment method is set. Bookings cannot be taken until you add at least one.
settings.paymentWarning: Changing these while holds are active means some customers may already have paid to the old details.
settings.settingsSaved: Settings saved. They apply to new bookings.
settings.invalid: Check the fields: names are required, prices are whole numbers, and the deposit is between 1 and 100.

staff.title: Staff
staff.empty: Add staff who can confirm payments and enter bookings.
staff.name: Name
staff.confirmDisable: Disable {name}? Their open sessions end immediately.
staff.passwordReset: Password reset. Their open sessions ended.
staff.lastOwner: There must always be one active owner.
staff.invalid: Check the fields: the login uses letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores (3 to 32), and the password needs at least 8 characters.
